assessment.question:
### Exercise 16.4: Use statistics given in a table to predict and plan

1. A stationery shop kept a record of the number of exercise books it sold in a week, as well as the total profit it made on the sale of these exercise books.

| Exercise book size | Numbers sold | Profit made on the sale of each book (in ₦) |
| ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 60 pages | 100 | 5 |
| 90 pages | 20 | 7 |
| 120 pages | 40 | 9 |

Use the table to answer the following questions.

1c. What is the total profit made on the sale of 90-page exercise books?
assessment.expected_answer: Total profit made on the sale of 90-page exercise books = $\text{20}\times{₦7} = \text{₦140}$

assessment.question:
### Exercise 16.4: Use statistics given in a table to predict and plan

2. This table shows some of the items sold in the local shop on a particular day, the number of each item sold that day, the price per item and the total amount earned by the item.

| Items sold | Number sold | Price/item in ₦ | Amount earned in ₦ |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 1 litre milk | 12 | 820 | $\text{12}\times{820}={9,840}$ |
| 1 kg rice | 20 | 700 | $\text{20}\times{700}={14,000}$ |
| 12 eggs | 15 | 600 | $\text{15}\times{600}={9,000}$ |
| 1 kg bananas | 22 | 500 | $\text{22}\times{500}={11,000}$ |
| 500 g cheese | 9 | 600 | $\text{9}\times{600}={5,400}$ |

2c. From which item sold did the shop keeper earn the least money?
assessment.expected_answer: The shop keeper earned the least money from cheese.
